name: Service-Based Architecture
forces_resolved: Coarse-grained domain segregation (4 to 10 domain services)
Shared monolithic database retains ACID transactions without distributed 2PC
Balanced deployability without extreme microservice orchestration overhead
forces_unresolved: Shared database remains a single point of failure and bottleneck
Database schema migrations require cross-service coordination
Coarser fault isolation compared to fine-grained microservices
applicability_conditions: Stepping stone migration from monolith towards microservices
Medium-sized organizations needing moderate independent deployability
Teams requiring shared database ACID integrity without distributed sagas
anti_requisites: Completely isolated data stores per domain required by regulatory compliance
Ultra-high throughput (> 100,000 rps) requiring partitioned independent databases
